These '''Endorian goats''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Goat/Legends|goat]] found on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] were known to have domesticated Endorian goats.

==Biology and appearance==
These creatures were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] quadrupedal [[Goat/Legends|goats]] with cloven hooves. They had a coat of straight [[Hair/Legends|hair]], the [[Color/Legends|coloration]] of which varied from white to black. Goats also had two pointed horns that grew upward from the head, and a long beard on the chin. Their tails were short and pointed upwards.<ref name="CCEA" />

These creatures would normally feed on leaves, twigs, shrubs and other [[Plant/Legends|plants]], but they sometimes tried to chew non-edible things such as ropes.<ref name="CCEA" />

==History==
The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Warrick family/Legends|Warrick family]] possessed at least two pet Endor goats. Just as [[Deej Warrick|Deej]] was preparing to search for his missing sons on a [[Hang-glider/Legends|skin glider]], one of his goat chewed through the rope that anchored the glider, causing Deej and his glider to take off before he was prepared. Deej soon took control, and managed to safely guide his glider to his sons.<ref name="CCEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In ''Caravan of Courage'' we can also see an owl in Logray's hut and some goats looking high on a hill for a lonely Ewok goatherd.|Tim Veekhoven and Mark Newbold|<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-present-familiar-creatures-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away|text=Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
While [[canon]], these creatures have never been officially named, although the Ewoks Deej and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] seem to call their Endor goat something like "Krishkneya".<ref name="CCEA" /> In [[2013]], Endorian goats were mentioned in [[Back from the Drawing Board|''Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away'']], an article written for the [[Star Wars Blog]] by [[Tim Veekhoven]] and [[Mark Newbold]].<ref name="Blog" />
